issues.message: RTBResponse.id "extension-point-999" does not echo the RTBRequest id "extension-point-001". The envelope id is the extension point request id, not the bid request id.
No metadata object: without api_version and model_version an orchestrator cannot record which agent build produced these mutations.

Intent BID_SHADE is not among the applicable_intents the request declared (ACTIVATE_SEGMENTS, ACTIVATE_DEALS, SUPPRESS_DEALS, ADJUST_DEAL_FLOOR, ADD_METRICS). The orchestrator listed what it is prepared to accept; anything else is rejected on arrival.
path "/seatbid/dsp-1/bid/bid-abc" targets a bid, but the request envelope carries no bid_response to mutate.
path "/imp/imp-404/pmp/deals/deal-premium" names impression "imp-404", which is not among the impressions the bid request carries ("imp-1").

path "/imp/imp-1/pmp/deals/deal-unlisted" names deal "deal-unlisted", which impression "imp-1" does not offer ("deal-premium", "deal-standard"). A floor or margin can only be adjusted on a deal the auction already carries.
Intent ACTIVATE_DEALS carries "ids", but the mutation sets adjust_bid.

This mutation uses the vocabulary of the ARTF v1.0 document's examples (intent "adjustDeals", op "replace", or a value wrapper such as IDsPayload) rather than the enum names and oneof members its .proto defines. The reference server speaks the proto encoding, so send INTENT/OPERATION enum names and top-level oneof members.

Intent ADJUST_DEAL_MARGIN is not among the applicable_intents the request declared (ACTIVATE_SEGMENTS, ACTIVATE_DEALS, SUPPRESS_DEALS, ADJUST_DEAL_FLOOR, ADD_METRICS). The orchestrator listed what it is prepared to accept; anything else is rejected on arrival.
Margin 140 is a PERCENT adjustment above 100, which would take the whole bid and more.
ADJUST_DEAL_MARGIN has no field in OpenRTB 2.6 to write to: margin is not part of the Deal object, so the orchestrator has to apply it out of band and no validator can check the result.
